brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu declared that forming a governing coalition with Arab parties would be "a disgrace and a shame," Al Jazeera English reported. Netanyahu's rejection of such arrangements comes as Israel navigates post-election coalition negotiations, a process that typically requires building majorities across diverse political factions.

The statement reflects longstanding tensions between Netanyahu's right-wing political base and Arab parties representing Palestinian citizens of Israel, who have occasionally participated in past governing coalitions.
dek: Netanyahu has called the prospect of working with Arab parties to form a government ‘a disgrace and a shame’.
title: Netanyahu rejects potential coalition with Arab parties
